def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    borrowed_amount_jpy = 1_000_000
    borrowing_rate = 0.005
    investment_rate = 0.05
    exchange_rate_brl_per_jpy = 0.05

    # Convert borrowed yen to Brazilian reals
    invested_amount_brl = borrowed_amount_jpy * exchange_rate_brl_per_jpy

    # Calculate investment earnings and borrowing cost
    investment_earnings = invested_amount_brl * investment_rate
    borrowing_cost_brl = borrowed_amount_jpy * borrowing_rate * exchange_rate_brl_per_jpy

    # Calculate the carry trade profit
    profit = investment_earnings - borrowing_cost_brl

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest integer
    return round(profit)
